summary: Cross-border modular-pallet equipment shipment held at customs; temporary floor and badge provisioning requested for relocating engineer
description:
Issue summary: A modular-pallet containing a standing desk frame, monitor arms, two 27\" monitors, and a dock power shelf for employee Mateo Rivera was sent from the US fulfillment center on 2026-03-09 but was held at Irish customs (CN22/manifest query). The courier reports 'insufficient commercial invoice information / missing EORI for recipient'.

Impact: Employee is relocating on 2026-03-16 and requires desk kit and badge access to be productive on arrival. Physical onboarding is at risk; team lead flagged critical blocker. No systems or data at risk. This is an internal operational priority (P1) due to relocation timeline.

Observed behavior: Courier (TransGlobal Couriers, AWB TG-4678-IE) updated tracking 2026-03-11: "Customs hold - awaiting documentation". Local broker requests updated commercial invoice with employer EORI and corrected HS codes. Dock team reports pallet is physically at Dock 3 inbound area but cannot be offloaded until customs releases.

Required outcome: (1) Clear customs and accept shipment into office storage, (2) Provision a temporary 1-week floor-level badge for Mateo to access 4th floor while permanent badge is processed, (3) Reserve a temporary desk + monitor arms pre-staging slot and schedule on-site handoff.

Reference/links: Slack thread #facilities (https://redwood.slack.com/archives/CFAC1234/p1678673000000), Courier AWB TG-4678-IE, packing list attached in 'attachments'.
steps_taken: 2026-03-11: Shipping contacted broker (GreenBorder Customs) to request required forms; broker indicated missing EORI and mismatched HS codes (previously shipped as general 'IT equipment' needs specific numeric HS codes).
2026-03-12 09:00: Dock team (Owen) confirmed pallet physically present at Dock 3 inbound and quarantined behind barrier.
2026-03-12 11:30: Security performed visual check and confirmed tamper-free seal; refused entry until customs release.
2026-03-12 15:00: Reporter reached out to Finance to obtain company EORI and updated commercial invoice. Finance requested AWB and original invoice copy for amendment.
comments: Elena Gomez (Facilities) 2026-03-12: 'Holding ticket — need finance to sign updated commercial invoice. Mateo's start date is 2026-03-16; temporary badge would mitigate risk.'

Marcus Li (Shipping) 2026-03-12: 'Engaged TransGlobal broker. They need company EORI (IR1234567) on new invoice. Also asking for detailed HS codes for monitors (8528.72) and desk frames (9403.20). Will file amendment once finance provides invoice.'

Aisling Byrne (Security) 2026-03-13: 'Can issue temporary floor-level escort badge (4th floor access) for up to 5 working days if Facilities provides request and business justification. Need request 24h lead time for badge printing.'

Mateo Rivera (Employee) 2026-03-13: 'Thanks — if I can get access and the monitors set up on day one, I can work remotely otherwise. I can also accept delivery to my local temporary residence if that helps.'
Finance (Liam O'Connor) 2026-03-13: 'Preparing updated commercial invoice; will include EORI, corrected HS codes and employer VAT number. ETA for invoice: 2026-03-14 10:00 UTC.'
investigation_notes: Broker report indicates most common failure is omission of EORI and generic HS codes. This is consistent with prior cross-border inbound shipments (see INT-61789).

Tracking shows cargo arrived into Shannon customs gateway on 2026-03-10 and was transferred to local holding yard; release requires corrected docs or payment of duties (unlikely for company-shipped hardware with proper invoice).
Dock team cannot accept physical handover until customs issues are cleared; warehouse storage authorized but billed to shipping team if extended beyond 48h.
Security confirms temporary badge process requires a signed request from manager plus positive ID verification on arrival; remote provisioning not permitted for first-time badges.
resolution_notes: Planned next steps: 1) Finance to upload amended commercial invoice to TransGlobal broker by 2026-03-14 10:00 UTC (owner: Liam). 2) Shipping (Marcus) to confirm broker receives docs and requests customs release; expect release window 24-48h after acceptance. 3) Facilities to coordinate pre-staging area and phone handoff once pallet released. 4) Security to prepare a 5-day temporary escorted badge for Mateo with printed ID; meet at reception.
Workaround (temporary): Security agreed to issue an escorted visitor badge for day-one productivity; Facilities will reserve a hotdesk and request IT to pre-stage monitor mounts for quick assembly.
If customs does not release by 2026-03-15 14:00, escalate to Head of Ops (R. Thompson) and consider expedited courier re-export or local rental monitors for first two weeks.
